notable_absence.finding: Beyond the Organization Owner prerequisite for org-wide setup, this page states no additional role requirement for the day-to-day usage the page walks through (generating queries, sample data, scopes/collections, SDK code) - any user with query-editor access appears able to use Capella iQ once the org has enabled it. This is consistent with configure-capellaiq.json's framing that once an Organization Owner accepts terms and enables the feature, 'Capella iQ is now available to all your organization's users.'

cross_component_finding: This page is overwhelmingly a UI walkthrough (click sequences, example prompts, favoriting queries) with almost no formal ontology structure of its own beyond what's already captured in configure-capellaiq.json and explore-iq-insights.json - confirming the batch hypothesis that even the Capella iQ pages are mostly thin once the access-control facts are pulled out. The one new fact here is the '(Preview)' labeling on SDK code generation, which recurs with ask-ai.md's public-preview framing and is captured as capellaiq:public-preview-stage.
